artworks.title: Jan Snellinx
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing from the waist up. He is in a three-quarter view, with one arm across his abdomen. He has a strong facial structure with a prominent nose, bushy eyebrows, full beard, and a bald head. His hair is dark and closely cropped on the sides. He is wearing a buttoned cloak or robe with small, round buttons down the front. The fabric looks thick and layered, with visible folds and creases. The background has an abstract pattern of lines that contrasts with the detailed figure.

artworks.title: Frans Snyders
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders illustration of a man's face. The man's head is slightly turned to his right. He has a well-defined face with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a full mustache and beard. His hair is short and wavy, neatly swept to the side. He wears a collared garment, visible only at the top. The background is plain and unadorned, with a visible texture indicative of pencil or pen and ink on paper, giving the entire piece a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Justus Suttermans
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing an upper-body portrait of a person. The individual is depicted with a slightly turned posture, facing forward. The facial features include high cheekbones, arched eyebrows, a pronounced mustache, deeply set eyes, and elegant curls falling above the shoulders. The person wears an elaborate garment with a detailed lace collar, large puffed sleeves, and a line of buttons at the neckline. The hands are clasped gently in front, with no visible accessories. The background is plain with an etched texture.

artworks.title: Lucas Vorsterman
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a man posing for a portrait. He is shown from about the mid-torso up, facing slightly to his right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has curly hair that reaches just above his shoulders, a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and stern facial features. He is wearing a garment with a large ruff collar and voluminous sleeves. His hands are crossed at his waist, holding a piece of fabric. The background is plain and unembellished.

artworks.title: Willem de Vos
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Schelte Adams Bolswert
artworks.description: The image shows an older man sitting in a relaxed posture. He has thick, wavy hair, a beard, pronounced eyebrows, and a slightly furrowed brow. He wears a coat with a high collar and visible buttons. One hand rests on his lap. The background is plain, with detailed shading.

artworks.title: Paul de Vos
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man from the shoulders up, in a three-quarter profile facing to the left. He has distinct facial features including a mustache, beard, sharp cheekbones, and medium-length wavy hair covering his ears and partially his forehead. He wears a formal outfit with a large, ruffled collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The etching detail around his face and collar is intricate. The background is a crosshatched texture, denser at the top and right sides of the head, fading into blank space below.

artworks.title: Paul de Vos
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Attributed to Joannes Meyssens
artworks.description: The image shows a man with distinct facial features, including a curled mustache and pointed beard. He is seated and slightly turned to his right, wearing a period garment with a wide pleated collar and a decorated button closure. He has wavy hair that extends to his neck and is draped in a patterned outer robe or cloak. One hand is on his lap, while the other rests with an open palm. The background has a finely hatched texture.

artworks.title: Jan de Wael
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is posed semi-profile, with his head turned slightly towards the viewer. The man has facial hair, a high forehead, deep-set eyes, and short, combed-back hair. He wears a ruffled collar and a textured garment with buttons down the front. The background has horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Figure of a Man [recto]
artworks.artist: Ventura Salimbeni
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a full-body sketch of a person standing. The person's position is slightly turned to the side with one arm extended outwards, while the other arm is bent across their torso. The face is roughly sketched, and the hair is of medium length and somewhat wavy. The person's clothing is drawn in loose, flowing lines, resembling robes or a long coat, and they seem to be holding a long, thin object. The background is plain, and there is a signature "Van Dyck" at the bottom of the sketch.

artworks.title: Petrus Stevens
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting the upper torso of a man. He is shown in a three-quarter view with his right arm posed akimbo, placing his hand on his hip. The man has a full mustache and goatee, along with wavy hair that is slightly receding at the temples. He wears a large ruffled collar that extends over his shoulders and a dark garment. A ring is visible on one of his fingers. The background features a detailed cross-hatch pattern, and the name "PETRUS STEVENS" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Jan van der Wouwer
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Paulus Pontius
artworks.description: The image portrays a man with distinct facial features, including a mustache and beard. He is wearing an ornate robe with fur trim, revealing a shirt with a large collar underneath. A chain is seen over his left shoulder, and he is holding a document in his left hand. He appears mature and dignified, with wavy hair, and is facing the viewer with a serious expression. The background features a textured surface that resembles draped fabric.

artworks.title: Jan Baptista Barbe
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view of a man's upper body. The man is positioned with his body slightly turned to the right, while his head is turned to face forward. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a full beard with wavy hair. The hair is styled with curls that frame his face. He wears a dark garment complemented by a white ruffled collar. His right hand is raised to his chest, with fingers positioned. The background of the image features architectural elements, including a column on the right side. The image displays the name "IOANNES BAPTISTA BARBE" below the portrait.

artworks.title: Adriaen Brouwer
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24 x 15.8 cm (9 7/16 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man in a half-body view. He is facing slightly to the right and looking directly at the viewer. The man has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a mustache with curled ends. He is wearing a garment with a high, pleated collar, a jacket with small buttons along the front, and a large draped sleeve. His hand is positioned near his waist. The background features a textured pattern, creating a classic and formal ambiance.

artworks.title: Marten Pepyn
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up. He has a full beard and moustache, neatly groomed hair, and is wearing a formal outfit with a white ruff around his neck and a cloak fastened with a belt. His hands are partially visible, one of them holding the fabric across his lap, and there are no visible items or jewelry. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Artus Wolfart
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: In the image, a person is shown from just below the chest up, with a focus on the upper body and head. The individual is in a slight three-quarter turn to the left, with hands draped in the garment in front of them. The person has a full beard, mustache, and well-groomed hair that is slightly wavy and receding at the temples. They are wearing a garment with a large lace collar and decorative buttons. There is no visible jewelry, and the hands appear to be holding the cloak around them. The background consists of a textured, dark space, which does not distract from the figure.

artworks.title: Frans Francken II
artworks.artist: Willem Hondius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his right, with his left hand resting on a ledge or table in front of him. The man has a contemplative expression, with his gaze directed off into the distance. His facial features include a pronounced brow, deep set eyes, a full beard, and a mustache. He has a furrowed forehead and slightly wavy hair that is combed back. He is dressed in period attire, featuring a dark robe with a white ruffled collar. The background is a dark, cross-hatched area. The bottom of the image includes text, identifying the figure as "FRANCISCVS FRANCK IVNIOR" and providing credits to the artist.

artworks.title: Willem Hondius
artworks.artist: Willem Hondius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He has a pointed goatee and mustache, short wavy hair, and is wearing a formal garment with ornate buttons. His hands are folded in front of him. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Adam de Coster
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man with facial hair standing against a textured background with an architectural column.

artworks.title: Adam de Coster
artworks.artist: Pieter de Jode II after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated in a relaxed pose with his right arm leaning on an unseen surface and his left hand resting on his knee or lap. The man's head is turned slightly to the side, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has facial hair and wavy medium-length hair. He is dressed in a dark, period-style garment with a high collar, ruffles on the shirt beneath, and a heavy outer garment. The background includes a large column on the right and cloud-like formations on the left, suggesting an outdoor setting or depth. The engraving is ornate and classical.

artworks.title: Cornelis van Poelenburgh
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man positioned slightly turned to his side, leaning slightly towards the viewer with his head turned to face the front. His hair is curly and reaches his shoulders, neatly framing his face, and he has a well-groomed mustache and goatee. He is wearing a voluminous, draped garment, likely a robe or cloak, over a collared shirt with only the collar visible. His hand is partially visible, holding the fabric of his garment near his chest. The background features a curtain on the right side and a textured wall or backdrop on the left side, which provides depth to the image. There are no other visible objects or jewelry in the image. The engraving includes the name "CORNELIVS POELENBORCH" prominently printed below.

artworks.title: Hendrick van Balen
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man facing slightly to his right. He has a thoughtful expression, a prominent nose, close-set eyes, wavy medium-length hair, and a full beard. He wears a detailed garment with a ruffled collar under a dark velvety coat. His left hand rests on a sculpted head on a plinth table. In the background, there is a vertical element resembling a column. The artwork includes an inscription identifying the subject as Henricus van Baelen and additional text in Latin.

artworks.title: Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. His body is slightly turned, and his face is facing the viewer. The man has long, curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is dressed in a dark doublet with a white collar and a cloak draped over his shoulder. He is holding part of the cloak with his left hand. The background features a cloudy sky. Text at the bottom identifies him as Gerardus Honthorst, with additional inscriptions.

artworks.title: Paulus Pontius
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing forward with his body slightly turned to the left, looking to the right. The man has prominent facial features including a nose, mustache, and curly hair that falls to his neck. He wears a detailed garment with an ornate collar and buttons. His right hand is resting on his hip. The background includes textured clouds and architectural structures.

artworks.title: Adriaen van Stalbemt
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 24.6 x 17.4 cm (9 11/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in a three-quarters view. His torso faces slightly left while his head turns right, looking into the distance. The man has distinguished features with a downward-curving mustache, short wavy hair, and historical attire. He wears a ruffled collar and a coat with buttons. One hand is visible, partially tucked into the coat with a ring on his finger. The background features vertical lines for texture. Below the man, there is text identifying him as "Adrianus Stalbent" and Latin inscriptions indicating his profession.
